GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hampered on jumping when crowded. After being crossed near the 1300m commenced to race keenly and was restrained from heels near the 1200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok worked to find lead. led turn under pressure. looked beaten 200 metres. just did enough # Every Chance

Debut for stable. Bumped @ start. Recovered & worked to race 2nd Two Wide (1L from lead) early . Stayed 2nd Two Wide midrace & 1 length clear on home turn. Joined leader @ 300m & pushed to lead @ 200m. Easily drew clear in last 150m. Gelded / blinkers off first time. # On-pace/won well.

Slow Out 1l. Restrained Inside tail keen 6l. 5l away midrace and Same to Turn between runners . Straightened Up 4l away Hard Ridden chasing. Battled On Well emerging 300m. hit front briefly 150m but No Match for winner's finish. vetted prior. vet post-race = lacerations # sound/had chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT:  to be ridden more conservatively: settled back .The horse, which was in a barrier adjoining the fractious rnr underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was passed fit to start. Blundered on jumping and lost ground. Approaching the 50m shifted out abruptly resulting in its rider having to stop riding and straighten his mount. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the horse to have small lacerations near the coronet band of the offside hind leg and to the nearside hind leg.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Settled Down Two Wide 4th, 4 Lengths @ 800m. enjoyed good trail to turn and Held Together Straightening Up all Clear . loomed to 200m then peaked a bit # given Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages.

Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear challenged @ 400 dueled again led x 1 Lengths @ 200 lay out held a margin until the last stride, # dictated, gave all
